shortDescription: Deploys a VMware virtual machine from an OVF or OVA file, placed on file system or HTTP server

options.name: allow_duplicates
options.description: Whether or not to allow duplicate VM names. ESXi allows duplicates, vCenter may not.

options.name: cluster
options.description: Cluster to deploy to. This is a required parameter, if O(esxi_hostname) is not set and O(hostname) is set to the vCenter server. O(esxi_hostname) and O(cluster) are mutually exclusive parameters.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: Datacenter to deploy to.

options.name: datastore
options.description: Datastore to deploy to.

options.name: deployment_option
options.description: The key of the chosen deployment option.

options.name: disk_provisioning
options.description: Disk provisioning type.

options.name: enable_hidden_properties
options.description: Enable source properties that are marked as C(ovf:userConfigurable=false).

options.name: esxi_hostname
options.description: The ESXi hostname where the virtual machine will run. This is a required parameter, if O(cluster) is not set and O(hostname) is set to the vCenter server. O(esxi_hostname) and O(cluster) are mutually exclusive parameters.

options.name: fail_on_spec_warnings
options.description: Cause the module to treat OVF Import Spec warnings as errors.

options.name: folder
options.description: Absolute path of folder to place the virtual machine. If not specified, defaults to the value of C(datacenter.vmFolder). Examples:    folder: /ha-datacenter/vm    folder: ha-datacenter/vm    folder: /datacenter1/vm    folder: datacenter1/vm    folder: /datacenter1/vm/folder1    folder: datacenter1/vm/folder1    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/vm    folder: folder1/datacenter1/vm    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/vm/folder2

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: inject_ovf_env
options.description: Force the given properties to be inserted into an OVF Environment and injected through VMware Tools.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the VM to work with. Virtual machine names in vCenter are not necessarily unique, which may be problematic.

options.name: networks
options.description: C(key: value) mapping of OVF network name, to the vCenter network name.

options.name: ovf
options.description: Path to OVF or OVA file to deploy. Required if O(url) is not set. O(ovf) and O(url) are mutually exclusive parameters.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: power_on
options.description: Whether or not to power on the virtual machine after creation.

options.name: properties
options.description: The assignment of values to the properties found in the OVF as key value pairs.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: resource_pool
options.description: Resource Pool to deploy to.

options.name: url
options.description: URL for OVA file to deploy. Required if O(ovf) is not set. O(url) and O(ovf) are mutually exclusive parameters.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the host to power on.

options.name: wait_for_ip_address
options.description: Wait until vCenter detects an IP address for the VM. This requires vmware-tools (vmtoolsd) to properly work after creation.
